segments.text: Ok so this is the human in the loop page for Google Antigravity on React Native, and I'm reporting a problem on this page.
This is the problem, it says tap a slot and the agent confirms the time, but that never happens.
This is my project, I've implemented the exact code from the doc.
Moving on to the demo. The slot card shows up fine, but after tapping a slot, uh, nothing changes, no confirmation and the card stays open.

That's what's breaking here, kindly have it fixed.
